source_rationale: Raw S3 explorer_blocks objects are a materially different storage representation from the already-tested Explorer blockDetails JSON surface. P0F is a source-schema audit only, not a retry of outcomes and not a rescue of the parent replication.

authorization_gate.rule: No S3 request may occur without a separate immutable P0F authorization amendment and the exact runtime confirmation.

deterministic_object_hypothesis.basis: Pre-execution observed archive hierarchy groups explorer_blocks into 100,000,000 / 1,000,000 / 100-height buckets with .rmp.lz4 objects.

cost_and_completeness_caps.rule: HEAD all four exact frozen keys before any GET. If any key is missing or caps would be exceeded, fail closed before body download.

schema_extraction_policy.hip3_guard: HIP-3 deployer setOracle alone is insufficient evidence for native BTC/ETH validator-oracle provenance.

decision_rule.PASS_NATIVE_ORACLE_SCHEMA_CANDIDATE: All four frozen raw objects exist, fit caps, decode under the frozen decoder, and expose at least one non-HIP-3 oracle-related key path or action/type/variant/kind label. This only permits a separately frozen P1 reconstruction audit.
decision_rule.FAIL_NO_NATIVE_ORACLE_SCHEMA_VISIBLE: All four frozen raw objects exist and decode within caps but expose no non-HIP-3 oracle-related schema candidate.
decision_rule.TECHNICAL_BLOCKED_SOURCE_COVERAGE: At least one frozen exact key is absent.
decision_rule.TECHNICAL_BLOCKED_COST_OR_DECODER: Byte caps or the frozen decoder prevent complete source-schema adjudication.
decision_rule.BLOCKED_NO_AUTHORIZATION: Separate P0F requester-pays authorization is absent.
